answer.book: Hipstedius, Dispositiones oratoriae in IV causarum generibus ex MSS Beati viri excerptae (Bremen 1683): one work of outlines in four genera of oratory (didascalic, demonstrative, deliberative, judicial), each a numbered series of disposed themes, preceded by a title, dedication, eulogy and verses, and closed by an index.
